interior.name: Interior only
interior.desc: Deep vacuum, upholstery and trim treated dry, glass cleaned inside and steam deodorising.

exterior.name: Exterior only

full.name: Interior + exterior

motoExterior.name: Full wash

motoSealed.name: Wash + sealant
